poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE WORLD IS VAST WITH ITS GOLDEN LIGHTS AND ECHOES OF DISTANT LANDS
poetryFrame.rightVertical: BUT TRUE BEAUTY RESIDES IN QUIET MOMENTS SHARED ONLY BETWEEN US
poetryFrame.bottomLine: SLOWING TIME DOWN FOR JUST YOU AND ME ON THIS AFTERNOON
sonnetLines: Let the grand journeys wait unseen,
The map can fold, the compass rest.
For where your gentle presence has been,
No city glow, no ocean spray,
Can match this quiet, steady grace.
We lose ourselves in time's soft delay,
Let hours stretch like amber light,
The wine grows cool within the glass.
Forget the stars throughout the night,
Just let the gentle moments pass.
This simple closeness is enough to keep,
A quiet promise while we sleep.

lyrics.text: I could travel to Paris and see the city lights
Ride a boat in Venice, what a beautiful sight
I could journey afar to an ocean so blue
But nothing is as beautiful as you
I could climb up a hill and watch the sunrise
Wander until the stars fill up the skies
But none of that matters if you aren't there, too
I wanna be next to you
If you would like to spend some time
I'd like to spend it with you
A glass of red wine
Just you and I
On a lazy afternoon
They say that someday the romance will fade
And tomorrow will be just another day
But even if we don't do anything at all
I wanna be where you are
If you would like to spend some time
I'd like to spend it with you
A glass of red wine
Just you and I
